scope_section_title: When to Consult: Scope of Clinical Practice
scope_section_desc: Comprehensive diagnostic workup and targeted clinical management following global evidence-based guidelines (ESPE, ESE, ADA) for pediatric and adult endocrine patients.
scope_1_desc: Hypothyroidism, Hyperthyroidism (Thyrotoxicosis), Autoimmune Thyroiditis (Hashimoto's), Goiter, and Thyroid Nodules.
scope_2_desc: Type 1 & Type 2 Diabetes, MODY, Neonatal Diabetes, Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM), and automated insulin delivery.
scope_3_desc: Short stature, growth velocity deceleration, Growth Hormone Deficiency (GHD), and bone age radiologic assessment.
scope_4_desc: Precocious or delayed puberty, hypogonadotropic/hypergonadotropic hypogonadism, and complex DSD evaluations.
scope_5_desc: Primary/secondary adrenal insufficiency (Addison's), Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia (CAH), and hypercortisolemia.
scope_6_desc: Pediatric and adult obesity, metabolic syndrome, severe insulin resistance, and dyslipidemia.
scope_7_desc: Central and nephrogenic diabetes insipidus, polyuria-polydipsia differential diagnosis, and serum osmoregulation.
scope_8_desc: Hypopituitarism, hyperprolactinemia (prolactinoma), pituitary adenomas, and post-craniopharyngioma hormonal substitution.
scope_9_desc: Rickets and rickets-like disorders, osteogenesis imperfecta/osteoporosis, severe Vitamin D deficiency, and parathyroid diseases.
scope_10_desc: Prader-Willi, Turner, Klinefelter, McCune-Albright, Noonan, and other monogenic or chromosomal syndromes.
scope_11_desc: Clonidine, Insulin Tolerance Test (ITT), Synacthen (ACTH), LHRH (GnRH), OGTT, and water deprivation protocols.
scope_12_desc: Hyponatremia, hypernatremia, hypokalemia, hypocalcemia, and systemic metabolic acidosis workup.
